item.tib: ma mo sbod gtong snang srid zil gnon gyi rgyud las ma 'ongs lung bstan snying gi rgya can
item.coloph: snyigs ma'i kho bo o rgyan las 'phro gling pas sa rta zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu yi nyin par shar rgyal mo rong chen ri bo drug cu rtsa gcig gi gtso bo dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse'i byang nub kyi gnas chen gnyen rje gab tog shel gyi rdo ring rtsa nas gter la thon pa phyis chu khyi hor zla lnga pa'i tshes la sharardza phyugs mo dpal ri'i mdun zhol dga' ldan dar rgyas gling du shog ser zhing du chags gang dkyus su khru do yig phreng bdun cu don lnga 'dug pa la ma mo rbod gtong gi rgyud cha lag cha rkyen dang bcas pa bod yig phab ste grub par bgyis pa'o
